# Boomtown Athletics

> Boomtown Athletics is a volleyball company in the Denver metro area. It runs tournaments, women's and men's leagues, training for adults and juniors, and drop-in volleyball. Everything takes place at Boomtown FieldhouseUSA, 14200 E Alameda Ave, Aurora, CO 80012. It serves adult and youth players, from people new to the sport to competitive teams.

Dates, times and registration links change often. The schedule page is the source of truth for anything dated. Do not rely on this file for current event dates.

## Key facts

- Location: Boomtown FieldhouseUSA, 14200 E Alameda Ave, Aurora, CO 80012. On-site parking is free. There is a bar and cafe on site.
- Courts: 8 hardwood volleyball courts and 5 sport courts.
- Sanctioning: events run under USAV, AVP and AAU. Boomtown hosts USAV-sanctioned qualifier play.
- Tournaments: one-day events. Formats are Reverse Co-Ed 4s, gendered 6s, women's and gendered 4s, and short-court doubles. There are no membership fees. Teams register per event through the schedule.
- Drop-in: Thursday through Monday, 7:00 to 11:00 PM. $10 per person plus fees for a one-day membership. Ages 14 and up, all levels. A waiver is required.
- Women's league: Queens Club, a women's 4s league. The season runs October to April, with a pre-season qualifier from August through October.
- Men's league: men's 4s. No qualifying. Teams sign up, and spots are limited.
- Co-ed leagues: run at the facility by partners Match Point Social and Volo.
- Adult training: coached sessions for beginners to pros, 90 minutes of training followed by play time, Friday 7:00 to 8:30 PM and Sunday 5:30 to 7:00 PM, $35 per person, which includes the drop-in fee. Private and small-group lessons by request.
- Youth training: runs through the partner club Colorado Boom (https://www.coloradoboom.com/programs.html), Tuesdays and Thursdays from 5:00 PM. Little Spikers ages 6 to 9, Developmental ages 8 to 16, Advanced ages 14 and up. $295 a month for twice a week, $150 a month for once a week, first week free. Coached by Colorado Boom coaches. Club players from any club are welcome; Colorado Boom club members can train both days for $150 a month. My Spark Denver accepted: $1,000 paid in full covers 6 months.
- Skill levels used for divisions: B, BB, A, AA and Open.
- Level of play: leagues and tournaments are competitive, not recreational.
- Contact: admin@boomtownathletics.com. Instagram: @boomtownvb.

- [Co-Ed Leagues](https://www.boomtownathletics.com/co-ed-leagues.html): co-ed leagues run by Match Point Social and Volo.
- [Training](https://www.boomtownathletics.com/training.html): volleyball training for adults (beginners to pros) and private lessons, plus youth training with Colorado Boom coaches, club-player pricing and sign-up by age group.
